h1: Empowering Belizean Business with Autonomous AI Agents
sub: Deploy dedicated 24/7 cloud AI agents that manage bookings, research regional markets, automate workflows, and code while you sleep.
audience: Belizean tour operators, resort managers, agro-exporters, maritime logistics firms, and offshore professional services.
manifesto: From the cayes to the Cayo District, Ceyo gives Belizean operators autonomous digital teams running 24/7 in the cloud—bridging Caribbean commerce and global enterprise effortlessly.

uses.d: Ambergris Caye resorts coordinate guest inquiries across international time zones, update booking engines, and log confirmations into Google Sheets automatically.
Orange Walk agricultural suppliers monitor regional freight indices, compile customs forms, and synchronize shipping manifests with scheduled autonomous web routines.
Cayo adventure lodges deploy Telegram bots to dispatch tour guides, confirm cave-tubing reservations, and send automated briefing packs to guests.
Belize City shipping coordinators track Caribbean vessel movements, compile cargo updates, and notify supply chain partners via daily scheduled summaries.
Belmopan tech consultants write, test, and deploy production-ready web apps directly inside an isolated cloud computer without manual server configuration.
Placencia property firms qualify international buyer leads, research comparative listings across the market, and file client data into connected CRMs.

steps.d: Select an autonomous specialist and spin up your dedicated cloud computer in moments.
Integrate Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, and CRMs across more than 1,000 platforms.
Assign scheduled browsing, coding, or communication routines that run around the clock.

chapters.d: Your hospitality bot reviews overnight dive inquiries from international travelers, drafts confirmations, and updates room allocations in your CRM. You begin your morning at San Pedro harbor with your bookings already organized.

While you inspect citrus groves in Stann Creek, your autonomous research agent checks regional bulk shipping tariffs and generates a pricing report. It updates your financial spreadsheets and flags any unexpected tariff adjustments.

In Belize City, your coding agent completes a localized property showcase portal and runs quality checks on the cloud computer. It notifies your sales team on Telegram that prospective buyer landing pages are live.

As Belize sleeps, your agents run scheduled routines tracking international exchange rates and monitoring global client tickets. Even with your phone switched off, your isolated cloud environment remains completely active.

faq.q: What are the subscription plans and free trial terms?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your card is linked at signup and billed only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Which languages can my Ceyo bots handle?
faq.a: Ceyo communicates fluently in English, Spanish, and dozens of other global languages, allowing Belizean teams to coordinate with regional Central American partners and global travelers effortlessly.

faq.q: How does the isolated cloud computer keep working when I am offline?
faq.a: Each bot operates on its own secure virtual machine hosted in the cloud. It executes browser actions, scheduled routines, and coding tasks continuously, regardless of whether your phone or computer is on.

faq.q: Can multiple bots collaborate together in Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can deploy your bots as individual assistants or add multiple specialist bots to a Telegram group chat where they coordinate tasks, share long-term memory, and execute joint workflows.

faq.q: What tasks can the autonomous browser and coder perform?
faq.a: The browser agent navigates live websites, fills forms, tracks supplier prices, and conducts structured research. The coding agent writes, runs, and tests code within its cloud sandbox, building tools and websites autonomously.
